title: The Moonlit Invitation
learning_focus: Story grammar, main idea, respectful invitation language, formal/informal tone, sequence, visual layout, and audience.
story_premise: A community center is preparing an evening meal during Ramadan, but the invitation page has lost its sequence and respectful wording. The Pathfinder works with the fictional host family and community coordinator to restore it.
mission_objective: Complete the three connected areas and apply the mission learning focus: Story grammar, main idea, respectful invitation language, formal/informal tone, sequence, visual layout, and audience.
